swap_risks: CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 55% (AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5 vs AP63300WU-7: 500 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63203WU-7: 3.9 µH p.13 vs AP63300WU-7: 6.8 µH p.2); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63203WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs AP63300WU-7 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 500 kHz (p.6) (2.2x ratio), typical inductor 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 6.8 µH (p.2), output mode fixed vs adjustable, and package θJA 89 vs 89 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP63203WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TPS54302DDCR, TPS563201DDCR & AP62200WU-7!" (p.1) and AP63300WU-7 "CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TI TPS54302/TPS54202/TPS563201/TPS562201 & AP62200!" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose AP63203WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) qualification and -40..85 °C grade; choose AP63300WU-7 when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
